description: This file appears to be a C++ source file implementing part of a WebKitBrowser plugin, with methods for managing browser properties, state, headers, cookie jar, and events such as state change and bridge queries.

classes.name: WebKitBrowser
classes.description: A class implementing a WebKit-based browser with properties and events for managing its state, headers, language preferences, cookie jar, and messaging.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all properties and methods exposed by the WebKitBrowser plugin.

methods.name: UnregisterAll
methods.description: Unregisters all previously registered properties and methods.

methods.description: Deletes a directory specified by the provided parameters.

methods.name: get_languages

methods.name: set_languages
methods.description: Sets the preferred languages for the browser.

methods.name: get_headers
methods.description: Retrieves headers sent with all browser requests.

methods.name: set_headers
methods.description: Sets headers to be sent with all browser requests.

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Gets the current running state of the browser service.

methods.name: set_state
